                  id="Definitions_Restaurant"

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerInstructions" name="Buzzer and instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerRinging" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealHandover" name="Meal handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CallGuest" name="Call to guest"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest meal process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Guest_Hungry" name="Feel hungry"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Guest_Enter" name="Enter restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Guest_ChooseDish" name="Choose dish from changing meal range"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Guest_WaitTurn" name="Wait for turn"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Guest_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with employee" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer" name="Receive buzzer and instructions" messageRef="Message_BuzzerInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Guest_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Guest_BuzzerRings_Definition" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRinging"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Guest_GoToHatch" name="Go to service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Guest_ArriveAtHatch" name="Arrive at service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Guest_ArriveAtHatch_Definition" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Guest_ReceiveMeal" name="Receive meal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Guest_EatMeal" name="Eat meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Guest_End" name="Meal eaten"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_1" sourceRef="Guest_Hungry" targetRef="Guest_Enter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_2" sourceRef="Guest_Enter" targetRef="Guest_ChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_3" sourceRef="Guest_ChooseDish" targetRef="Guest_WaitTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_4" sourceRef="Guest_WaitTurn" targetRef="Guest_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_5" sourceRef="Guest_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_6" sourceRef="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_7" sourceRef="Guest_BuzzerRings" targetRef="Guest_GoToHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_8" sourceRef="Guest_GoToHatch" targetRef="Guest_ArriveAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_9" sourceRef="Guest_ArriveAtHatch" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_10" sourceRef="Guest_ReceiveMeal" targetRef="Guest_EatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Guest_Flow_11" sourceRef="Guest_EatMeal" targetRef="Guest_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Restaurant" name="Restaurant meal service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="Restaurant_LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_OrderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_EnterPOS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_CollectMoney</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_PassBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_InformChef</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_SetOffBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_WaitForArrivalOrTimer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_GuestArrives</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_FiveMinuteTimer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_CallGuest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Employee_HandOverMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Restaurant_End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Chef_PlaceMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Chef_InformEmployee</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Restaurant_OrderReceived_Definition" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Employee_EnterPOS" name="Enter order into POS system"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Employee_CollectMoney" name="Collect money from guest"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_PassBuzzer" name="Pass buzzer and explain signal" messageRef="Message_BuzzerInstructions">

    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Employee_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Chef_PrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Chef_PlaceMeal" name="Place meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Chef_InformEmployee" name="Inform employee meal is ready"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_SetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRinging"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Employee_WaitForArrivalOrTimer" name="Wait for guest or five minutes"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Employee_GuestArrives" name="Guest arrives at service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="Employee_GuestArrives_Definition" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Employee_FiveMinuteTimer" name="Five minutes pass">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Employee_FiveMinuteTimer_Definition">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_CallGuest" name="Call guest" messageRef="Message_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Employee_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Restaurant_End" name="Meal handed over"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_1" sourceRef="Restaurant_OrderReceived" targetRef="Employee_EnterPOS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_2" sourceRef="Employee_EnterPOS" targetRef="Employee_CollectMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_3" sourceRef="Employee_CollectMoney" targetRef="Employee_PassBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_4" sourceRef="Employee_PassBuzzer" targetRef="Employee_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_5" sourceRef="Employee_InformChef" targetRef="Chef_PrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_6" sourceRef="Chef_PrepareMeal" targetRef="Chef_PlaceMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_7" sourceRef="Chef_PlaceMeal" targetRef="Chef_InformEmployee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_8" sourceRef="Chef_InformEmployee" targetRef="Employee_SetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_9" sourceRef="Employee_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Employee_WaitForArrivalOrTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_10" sourceRef="Employee_WaitForArrivalOrTimer" targetRef="Employee_GuestArrives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_11" sourceRef="Employee_WaitForArrivalOrTimer" targetRef="Employee_FiveMinuteTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_12" sourceRef="Employee_FiveMinuteTimer" targetRef="Employee_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_13" sourceRef="Employee_CallGuest" targetRef="Employee_WaitForArrivalOrTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_14" sourceRef="Employee_GuestArrives" targetRef="Employee_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Restaurant_Flow_15" sourceRef="Employee_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Restaurant_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Restaurant_Collaboration" name="Restaurant meal service collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Guest_Participant" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Restaurant_Participant" name="Restaurant" processRef="Process_Restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Meal order" sourceRef="Guest_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Restaurant_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerInstructions" name="Buzzer and instructions" sourceRef="Employee_PassBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerRinging" name="Buzzer rings" sourceRef="Employee_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Guest_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest arrives" sourceRef="Guest_ArriveAtHatch" targetRef="Employee_GuestArrives"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealHandover" name="Meal handover" sourceRef="Employee_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Guest_ReceiveMeal"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CallGuest" name="Call to guest" sourceRef="Employee_CallGuest" targetRef="Guest_Participant"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that an activity, event, or decision outcome leads to a specific next action: connect the corresponding BPMN elements with sequence flows, including the stated successor of each branch
rules.situation: the description states that an activity or event leads to a specific next activity or event in the same process scope

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or event together with contextual details that do not change its core action or outcome: Use a concise label for the core action or outcome, adding contextual details only when needed to distinguish its meaning from other modeled elements.
rules.situation: the description states an activity or event together with contextual details that do not change its core action or outcome

rules.instruction: When the description describes distinct participants communicating or exchanging an item, with an action by each participant: Model each described exchange as a message flow from the sending interaction node to the receiving interaction node in separate participant pools; represent distinct exchanges separately rather than combining them into one interaction.
rules.situation: the description identifies distinct participants who perform actions and exchange information or items

rules.instruction: Create bpmn:collaboration when distinct participants interact and represent every participant as a bpmn:participant pool.
rules.situation: the description assigns work to distinct participants who communicate directly with one another

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states that a participant transfers or receives value as a distinct step in a workflow: model that action as an activity in the stated sequence
rules.situation: the description explicitly states that a participant transfers or receives value as a distinct step in a workflow
